master_id_map: only ~23% of complaint records could be traced to a warranty claim (chassis_no), and only ~6% traced all the way to a job card (mobile_hash). This is expected given the data model — not every complaint results in a warranty claim, and not every warranty claim has an associated job card in the same year. The 8% blank vehicle_reg_no reflects complaints with no vehicle identifier at all, an unrecoverable gap. Only records with a non-null chassis_no/mobile_hash can be used for cross-system, vehicle-level analysis (e.g. tracing a complaint through to its warranty cost and repair job)."

"Recomputed tat_days from cleaned dates in both service_complaints_2023 and service_complaints_2024 (post-deduplication). 2023: 53% matched original tat_days, 19.4% mismatched, 15% showed negative TAT (resolution recorded before complaint — a genuine data integrity issue), 11.5% excluded as still-open (no resolution_date). 2024: notably cleaner — 64.7% matched, 6.2% mismatched, 0% negative TAT, 28.9% still-open. This suggests improved data quality/process maturity in Ola's 2024 service tracking versus 2023. Recomputed tat_days used in all further TAT-based analysis for both years; original column retained for reference only."
